title: Search Explain API Contract
text: The search explain endpoint returns matched terms, lexical score, vector score, fusion score, selected mode, and per-result reasons.

title: Search Explain API Contract
text: Clients use the search explain endpoint to debug why a cell was returned for a query and to compare lexical, vector, and hybrid behavior.

title: Storage Validation Runbook
text: Storage validation checks the manifest, segment files, bitmap indexes, lexical indexes, vector indexes, HNSW graph files, candidate ids, and WAL scan.

title: Storage Validation Runbook
text: Repair should start with dry-run mode before applying cleanup. Operators should inspect planned orphan cleanup and WAL truncation before mutation.

title: SDK Release Gate
text: The SDK release gate requires package dry-runs, live local server contract tests, registry publication guardrails, examples artifact packaging, and deprecation policy checks.

title: SDK Release Gate
text: SDK publication is manual-only, tag-gated, and bound to a protected release environment before PyPI, npm, or crates.io publication.

title: Server Security Configuration
text: Server security configuration includes bearer tokens, policy-store principals, request body limits, per-token quotas, CORS allowlist, and tenant validation.

title: Server Security Configuration
text: Audit log redaction removes sensitive query, body, and token data while preserving route metadata and stable action classes.

title: Query Routing Strategy
text: Query routing chooses lexical, vector, or hybrid retrieval based on query shape. Explain output should include the selected strategy.

title: Query Routing Strategy
text: Fallback reason should be visible when ANN is not production safe, when recall guardrails fail, or when exact scan is required.
